reviews.text:
The first time I visited, I was seeking a second opinion, but all the doctors here immediately performed ultrasounds, X-rays, and blood tests on the spot. Even if it was past the scheduled consultation time, the doctors and staff wholeheartedly cared for my dog ​​and my family. While my dog ​​was being examined, the receptionist gave him some candy and told him to relax. That thoughtful gesture really comforted me. It's a truly warm and wonderful hospital with amazing doctors.

I'm so glad I found Hiroo no Mori Animal Hospital.

Dr. Ogawa, thank you so much for everything. Your bright smile, your attentive listening, and the various tests you perform with my dog's best interests in mind have truly helped not only my dog ​​but also us humans.

Thank you so much for everything.

We look forward to your continued support.

And if anyone is struggling to find a suitable pet hospital, I highly recommend visiting Hiroo no Mori!

I think the service from the hospital director and staff is wonderful. They give detailed advice, which is very helpful.

They treat patients with genuine care and attention, making it a very trustworthy hospital. It's always crowded, but I can understand why.
The staff and teachers were so kind and helpful; I would definitely like to rely on them again if anything comes up in the future. Thank you very much.

Everyone is so kind.
When I visited because my Maltipore puppy was showing symptoms of patellar luxation, I was so touched by their love for dogs that I canceled my free vaccination appointment and had him vaccinated here instead.
Everyone's gentle approach to dogs naturally brings a smile to my face.
I'll definitely come again.

In June, we said goodbye to Mikan (the black one) at 14 years and 10 months old.

We also want Karin (the white one), who is 11 years old, to live a long life, so we took her for a pet checkup today.

We take her for checkups every year.

We left her with peace of mind today as well.

We hope the number of stones hasn't increased... 🙏

I previously lost my beloved dog after she underwent spaying surgery, and since then, I've been very careful when choosing a veterinary clinic.

Recently, I adopted a new dog and researched many veterinary clinics. This clinic had many positive reviews and ratings, so I thought I could entrust my dog ​​to them with peace of mind. I visited for the first time for vaccinations, a check-up, and nail trimming.

During the check-up, the vet trimmed my dog's nails right in front of me, but I was shocked to see my dog's nails bleeding and blood dripping.

While some bleeding might occur during nail trimming, my previous experience made me anxious about leaving my precious dog at a hospital or having them treated. Seeing the bleeding right in front of me terrified me so much that I broke out in a cold sweat.

That's why I was so disappointed, especially since I had researched many clinics, carefully chosen this one, and had a good impression from the reviews.

I don't know if there's a right answer when choosing a veterinary clinic, and I'm still afraid of where I can entrust my beloved dog with peace of mind. This incident has made me feel that I cannot confidently entrust my dog ​​to this clinic in the future.
I always bring my dog ​​here for checkups. The doctor's diagnoses are accurate, and all the nurses are very kind. I appreciate that I can make appointments, which means shorter waiting times.

This time, our beloved dog Dobby (a Chihuahua) developed an anal gland inflammation, and we visited this animal hospital for the first time.

Although this was our first visit and examination, we were truly impressed by the wonderful service we received from start to finish.

I can speak Japanese, but I'm still a little unsure about specialized Japanese related to animal hospitals and veterinary medicine. My wife doesn't speak Japanese, and her English is only intermediate, so we were a little worried about receiving specialized explanations at the animal hospital.

However, this hospital had a veterinarian who spoke very fluent English. The explanations were very easy to understand, and they answered our questions carefully, which was a great relief.

What made us happiest was how they treated Dobby. They were so gentle and careful, and it was clear they cared for him as if he were their own pet. Dobby was able to receive the examination without any worries.

We have used two other animal hospitals in Tokyo before, but this was the first time we encountered one that was so kind and attentive to both the owner and the pet.

I thought the fees were very reasonable.

Before starting any examination or treatment, they clearly provided and explained the cost estimate, so I knew exactly what would cost and felt very reassured. They also clearly explained the materials and procedures used, and the pricing was very transparent.

They accept not only cash but also credit cards.

I was also happy to receive a small gift like treats for my pet. I thought these little touches were wonderful.

The Elizabethan collar Dobby is wearing in the photo, with its sunflower design, was purchased at this hospital 🌻
It's very cute, and they had other colors and designs available. It's great that you can purchase pet supplies like this in addition to getting your pet examined.

The examination room has glass walls, so you can see inside from the outside. This time, my wife went into the examination room with Dobby, and the doctor was very kind and attentive, so we felt completely at ease leaving our pet in their care.

I would especially recommend this animal hospital to foreigners.

If you're worried about things like, "I don't speak much Japanese, will that be okay?", "Will they understand English?", or "Will they explain things properly?", then you can rest assured that you'll be able to visit this clinic with confidence.

Communication in English was very smooth, and the explanations were thorough. The fees were reasonable, and I didn't get the impression that they were pushing anything unnecessary. I felt it was a very trustworthy hospital.

This was my first visit, but I've found a hospital that I want to continue going to.

In the future, if something happens to Dobby, or even if something happens to my 6-year-old cat, I want to take her to this hospital.

Google Maps only allows up to 5 stars, but if I could, I would give it 10 stars.

To the doctor and staff, thank you so much for examining Dobby so carefully this time.

I look forward to continuing to use your services.

I wholeheartedly recommend this animal hospital.

This was our first visit to this veterinary clinic, and we honestly could not have asked for a better experience.

We brought our Chihuahua, Dobby, because his anal gland was inflamed. From the moment we arrived until the end of the consultation and treatment, everyone was incredibly kind, professional, and attentive.

I speak Japanese, but I am not completely confident with the specialized vocabulary used in veterinary medicine. My wife does not speak Japanese, and although her English is intermediate, veterinary terminology can be difficult even in English. So, we were a little nervous about whether we would be able to communicate properly.

Thankfully, there was a veterinarian at this clinic who spoke English perfectly. She explained everything very clearly, answered all of our questions patiently, and made us feel completely comfortable.

What impressed us the most was how wonderfully she treated Dobby. She was extremely gentle, caring, and affectionate with him. It was very clear that she genuinely cared about his well-being, and Dobby was comfortable and calm throughout the visit.

We have already been to two other veterinary clinics in Tokyo, and honestly, none of them gave us the same level of care and attention that we experienced here. This was our first visit, but we immediately felt that we had finally found a veterinary clinic we could truly trust.

The prices are also very reasonable and fair.

Before starting any examination or treatment, they clearly explain the estimated cost, so you know what you will be paying for. They are very transparent about the procedures and materials being used, and we never felt pressured into unnecessary treatments or expenses.

They accept both cash and credit cards, which is also very convenient.

They also gave Dobby some treats as a little gift, which was such a lovely touch. It really shows how much they care about their patients, not only medically but also as pets.

The Elizabethan collar Dobby is wearing in the photo, which looks like a little sunflower 🌻, was also purchased at this clinic. They had different colors and designs available, and we thought it was incredibly cute. It’s nice that you can also purchase useful and adorable pet items there.

The consultation room has transparent glass, so you can see inside from outside if you prefer. My wife went into the consultation room with Dobby, and everything went perfectly. We felt completely comfortable and trusted the veterinarian throughout the entire process.

I especially recommend this clinic to foreigners living in Tokyo.

If you are worried about not speaking Japanese well, or you’re afraid that a veterinary clinic may not be able to communicate with you in English, you can come here without hesitation. The English communication was excellent, the explanations were clear, the prices were fair, and everything was very transparent.

We never felt that anyone was trying to take advantage of us or recommend unnecessary things. The entire experience felt honest, professional, and genuinely caring.

Even though this was our first visit, we already know that this will be our veterinary clinic from now on.

We will definitely bring Dobby here again if he ever needs veterinary care, and we will also bring our six-year-old cat here if he needs to see a veterinarian in the future.

Google Maps only allows five stars, but if I could give 10 stars, I absolutely would.

Thank you so much to the veterinarian and the entire staff for taking such wonderful care of Dobby. We are truly grateful, and we highly recommend this clinic!

I had such a wonderful experience at this veterinary clinic with my Chihuahua, Dobby. The veterinarians were incredibly professional, kind, and caring, and they treated Dobby with so much love and patience.
As a foreigner, I was especially grateful that they speak English perfectly. Communication was very easy, and I never felt worried about not understanding what was happening. They explained everything clearly, including each procedure they were performing during the consultation, which made me feel very comfortable and reassured.
I also loved the little pet treat area where you can choose some snacks to take home for your pets. It was such a thoughtful and lovely touch!
I truly had a great experience and highly recommend this clinic, especially to other foreigners who may feel nervous about visiting a veterinarian in Japan. You can feel completely comfortable coming here.
I will definitely bring my pets here whenever they need veterinary care in the future. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Dobby!
